_doc: Size + comment ratchet. New files must stay under maxNewFileLines. Listed files must not grow. Comment share per directory must not rise. Lower these numbers as the specs are split; never raise one without a note in 'exceptions'.
_dirsNote: helpers/ is shared by the whole harness and has no one feature: config.js feeds every other module and the specs compose them freely, so it is frozen at today's count and may only shrink.

_notes.e2e/tests/browser/chat.spec.js: 636 and the one file far over the cap: it is a single `test.describe` over one chat panel — dock, float, resize, compact popover, fullscreen clone — whose cases share the `settle` and `pointClearOfPanel` waits. Splitting it by state is the way down, not a helpers/ file the specs would import.
_notes.commentPct: Recorded from this lint's own count on the first run of the ratchet, with nothing rewritten. `e2e` is the single `playwright.config.js`, whose banner explains the project split, so one file sets the whole directory's share.
